items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...He's currently, I believe, playing with Nat Pierce-Randy Capp's Juggernaut.

ctx.x: And he does a lot of Charlie Parker originals with the reeds... Well, he does them with different combinations. George Bohannon playing trombone... I think maybe he should do a record on his own, with some new material. I'm not against what he's doing, but I think some new material that would be fresh to people. Because he is a truly marvelous musician.
Yes, he certainly is. And he's been a part of many important bands, as well as recording sessions and soundtracks. He's currently, I believe, playing with Nat Pierce-Randy Capp's Juggernaut.
